title: 第9章 一拳伤余庆第10章 斩杀余庆
slug: 穿越修真界开局娶了美女大师姐
lines: “呵呵，为何？阁主，老夫和三长老，只不过是顺应时势罢了。老夫前日已说得明明白白，玄武大陆修真界即将重新洗牌，以云霄阁的实力，如果不与其他宗门联合，结局只有被吞并蚕食。阁主，莫非你以为，以你之力，能得住？”大长老捋着花白的胡须，满脸讥诮。
“所以，你和三长老就暗中投靠青云宗，作为他们的内应？吃里扒外的东西！呸！”五长老吐了口唾沫，对着大长老怒骂。
“老五，你这牛脾气得改改了，急赤白脸解决不了任何问题。识时务者为俊杰。”三长老开口道。
莫唯风缓缓站起来，右手捂着胸口。他拦住五长老，示意他不要做口舌之争。
“这么说，大长老、三长老这是要叛出云霄阁了？”莫唯风盯着大长老的眼睛，一字一句地说。
大长老不与莫唯风对视，他看向莫唯风身边的其他长老、殿主，以及一众弟子，开口道：“各位，莫唯风一意孤行。老夫与三长老愿代表云霄阁，与青云宗并宗。各位可要想好，是随我二人与青云宗并宗，还是与莫唯风一样，自取灭亡。”
说完，大长老又向余东海道：“余宗主，莫唯风已被老夫重创，战力已失，其他人等不足为虑。老夫与三长老是云霄阁的人，不便对自己人动手，余宗主就看着办吧。”
余东海仰头哈哈一笑，然后看向莫唯风：“怎么样莫阁主，惊不惊喜意不意外？我本意并非如此，我也想你我携手，共图两宗发展大业，奈何你顽固不化，余某只好出此下策。”
莫唯风轻咳一下，嘲讽道：“事已至此，余宗主就不必惺惺作态了。你早就与大长老、三长老勾结，企图里应外合，还来说这漂亮话，让人听着恶心。”
余东海把脸一拉，“那就休怪我余某无情，云霄阁，我要定了。”
“哦？你就那么肯定，你能吃得下我云霄阁？”莫唯风一脸淡定。
“你已受重伤，谁还能阻我？”对莫唯风强装出来的淡定，余东海不以为然。
“拿下！”莫唯风突然暴喝一声。
云霄阁众人还不明所以的时候，大长老、三长老分别扑向二长老和传功殿殿主，两人分别出掌，将二长老和传功殿殿主重创。
莫唯风微微一笑，对余东海说道：“这二人是你安插在我云霄阁的内应吧？”
余东海面色一变，没想到两颗藏得很深的棋子已经被莫唯风拔掉了。
他看向云霄阁大长老和三长老，“大长老，原来你们两人欺骗于我，并无真心于我合作？”
大长老呵呵笑道：“余宗主，老夫与三长老生是云霄阁的人，死是云霄阁的鬼。先前，不过是顺着余宗主之意，演一场戏罢了，顺便看看能不能揪出内鬼。没想到，还真有所收获。”
余东海啪啪啪地拍了拍手，“很好，连我也骗过了。那么莫阁主，你受伤也是假的吧？”
莫唯风挺直身体，将嘴角的血迹擦去，微笑道：“正是。余宗主，若你要强取我云霄阁，莫某随时奉陪！”
余东海取出佩剑，缓缓走向莫唯风，“好，那我就领教领教莫阁主的剑法。”
然后，他转头对着青云宗众人道：“速战速决，今日必取云霄阁！”
“是！”青云宗一众长老、弟子分别朝着云霄阁众人杀过去。
莫唯风看着缓缓走过来的余东海，也抽出了佩剑。为了云霄阁弟子尽量少一些伤亡，他必须速战速决。
content_en:
"Haha, why? Pavilion Master, I and the third elder are just adapting to the current situation. I made it clear the day before yesterday that the Xuanwu Continent's cultivation world is about to be reshuffled. With the strength of Yunxiao Pavilion, if it does not unite with other sects, it will only end up being annexed and cannibalized. Pavilion Master, do you think that with your power, you can survive?" The elder stroking his gray beard, his face full of ridicule.
"So, you and the third elder secretly defected to the Qingyun Sect as their internal agents? You eat everything inside and out! Bah!" The fifth elder spat and cursed at the first elder.
"Lao Wu, you have to change your bad temper. Being anxious and white-faced will not solve any problems. Those who know the current affairs are heroes." The third elder said.
Mo Weifeng slowly stood up and covered his chest with his right hand. He stopped the fifth elder and signaled him not to engage in verbal disputes.
"So, the First Elder and the Third Elder are going to betray Yunxiao Pavilion?" Mo Weifeng stared into the First Elder's eyes and spoke word by word.
The Great Elder did not look at Mo Weifeng. He looked at the other elders, the hall master, and the disciples beside Mo Weifeng, and said, "Everyone, Mo Weifeng insists on his own way. I and the third elder are willing to represent Yunxiao Pavilion and merge with the Qingyun Sect. You must think carefully about whether you will join the Qingyun Sect with the two of me, or you will destroy yourself like Mo Weifeng."
After saying that, the First Elder said to Yu Donghai: "Sect Master Yu, Mo Weifeng has been severely injured by me and has lost his combat power. There is nothing to worry about others. I and the third elder are from Yunxiao Pavilion. It is not convenient for them to attack one of their own, so Sect Master Yu will just do whatever it takes."
Yu Donghai raised his head and laughed, then looked at Mo Weifeng: "How about Pavilion Master Mo, are you surprised or not? That was not my intention. I also want you and me to work together to develop the two sects. But you are stubborn, so Yu has no choice but to make this move."
Mo Weifeng coughed slightly and said mockingly: "Now that the matter has come to an end, Sect Master Yu no longer needs to be pretentious. You have long been colluding with the First Elder and the Third Elder in an attempt to coordinate inside and outside, and you still say such beautiful words, which makes people feel sick."
Yu Donghai pulled his face, "Then don't blame me, Yu, for being ruthless. Yunxiao Pavilion, I'm determined."
"Oh? Are you so sure that you can eat my Yunxiao Pavilion?" Mo Weifeng looked calm.
"You have been seriously injured, who can stop me?" Yu Donghai disapproved of Mo Weifeng's pretended calmness.
"Take it!" Mo Weifeng suddenly shouted.
When everyone in Yunxiao Pavilion was still unaware of what was going on, the First Elder and the Third Elder pounced on the Second Elder and the Master of the Chuan Gong Hall respectively. They each used their palms to severely injure the Second Elder and the Master of the Chuan Gong Hall.
Mo Weifeng smiled slightly and said to Yu Donghai: "These two are your internal agents in my Yunxiao Pavilion, right?"
Yu Donghai's expression changed. Unexpectedly, two deeply hidden chess pieces had been pulled out by Mo Weifeng.
He looked at the First Elder and the Third Elder of Yunxiao Pavilion, "First Elder, it turns out that you two deceived me and did not sincerely cooperate with me?"
The first elder chuckled and said: "Sect Master Yu, I and the third elder are people of Yunxiao Pavilion in life, and they are the ghosts of Yunxiao Pavilion in death. Previously, they were just following the wishes of Sect Master Yu to put on a show, and see if they could find out the inner ghost. Unexpectedly, they really gained something."
Yu Donghai clapped his hands and said, "Very good, even I have been deceived. So Pavilion Master Mo, your injury is fake, right?"
Mo Weifeng straightened his body, wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, and said with a smile: "Exactly. Sect Master Yu, if you want to take my Yunxiao Pavilion by force, Mo will be with you at any time!"
Yu Donghai took out his sword and slowly walked towards Mo Weifeng, "Okay, then I will learn Pavilion Master Mo's sword skills."
Then, he turned to the people of Qingyun Sect and said: "Quick fight, we will take Yunxiao Pavilion today!"
"Yes!" The elders and disciples of the Qingyun Sect rushed towards the people in Yunxiao Pavilion and killed them.
Mo Weifeng looked at Yu Donghai who was slowly walking over and also drew his sword. In order for Yunxiao Pavilion disciples to suffer as few casualties as possible, he must fight quickly.
